summary: Short, steep north kerb near a junction, homes 15-17 m behind.
reasons: Little sign of parking on this kerb

best_section.where: Hunter Street north kerb, east of the side-street junction, beside the tall hedge

drivers.seclusion: Hedge-screened house 15 m behind the kerb; another 17 m east; open park-like land across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerbside lane; one car seems to be parked there, so a van would fit.
drivers.traffic: Wider through road with lane markings, moderate traffic near the junction.
drivers.convention: Little kerb parking visible; weekday 7am-12 noon no-parking sign.

flags: Homes within 25 m on the section's own side
sun_shade: Hedge and trees shade the section from the north in the morning; open to the south.
cannot_judge: Whether the road is a through route used by commuters
